hooks.command: if [ -f "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/loom_checker.py" ]; then exec python3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/loom_checker.py" push --hook; else cat >/dev/null; echo "loom: publication hook failed (installed checker is unavailable at ${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/loom_checker.py; restart Codex to load the installed plugin version); allowing." >&2; exit 0; fi
